scope: Completed NOR maintenance incident; not SD/camera benchmark data. Root was the sole hardware owner. This archive was assembled and independently checked offline.

failure.meaning: WEL_FAILURE: post-program WEL-clear check in write_finished()
failure.note: Final status/security0 are cleanup results; they do not preserve the earlier WEL observation. Failure stays recorded rather than accepted as success.

diagnosis.interpretation: Readback proves the reported page bytes are correct; it does not prove why WEL was observed set. No timing, power or device-defect cause is established.

repair.policy: One explicitly authorized repair from freshly read actual partial contents. The same frozen helper and all CRC/idle/WEL/readback guards remained unchanged. No automatic retry or reset was used.

limits: The controller/helper completed and restored known idle configuration before diagnosis; no uncertain or active operation was treated as safe.
Parent bench owner reports no reset/power interruption during diagnosis/repair; archived CLI calls contain no reset or power command.
Success establishes exact programmed bytes and unchanged following guard, not the cause of the transient WEL observation or immunity to recurrence.
